Sandbox_RVA_Vehicles_tooltip:
Removes every vanilla vehicle from every spawn zone.
Modded vehicles are left alone, so this is the option to use when you want a car pack to fill the world by itself.
Sandbox_RVA_Vehicles_Everyday_tooltip: Ordinary cars found in parking stalls, trailer parks and poor or average neighbourhoods.
Sandbox_RVA_Vehicles_SportsLuxury_toolti: Sports cars, luxury cars and dealership stock.
Sandbox_RVA_Vehicles_PolicePrison_toolti:
Police cruisers, state police, sheriff and prison transport.
Also disables the regional police vehicle swap.
Sandbox_RVA_Vehicles_Emergency_tooltip: Fire trucks, ambulances and ranger vehicles.
Sandbox_RVA_Vehicles_WorkDelivery_toolti: Trade vans, delivery step vans, farm and business vehicles.
Sandbox_RVA_Vehicles_Trailers_tooltip: Towable trailers, horseboxes and livestock trailers.
Sandbox_RVA_Vehicles_BurntCrashed_toolti: Burnt-out wrecks and the smashed cars placed by roadside story events.
Sandbox_RVA_Vehicles_TrafficJams_tooltip: The cars that make up highway traffic jams.
Sandbox_RVA_Vehicles_Junkyard_tooltip: Junkyard stock and random roadside crash vehicles.
Sandbox_RVA_Vehicles_Story_tooltip: The pools used by randomised roadside stories: evacuees, tradesmen, race cars and so on.
Sandbox_RVA_Clothing_tooltip:
Removes all clothing, armour, accessories and bags.
Turning this on makes the individual clothing options below redundant.
Sandbox_RVA_Clothing_Shirts_tooltip: T-shirts, shirts, vests, sweaters and jerseys.
Sandbox_RVA_Clothing_FullBody_tooltip: Dresses, boilersuits, full suits and costumes.
Sandbox_RVA_Clothing_Armor_tooltip: Body armour, padding, holsters and protective plating.
Sandbox_RVA_Clothing_Jewelry_tooltip: Necklaces, rings, earrings, watches, belts and makeup.
Sandbox_RVA_Clothing_Bags_tooltip: Backpacks, duffel bags, purses and fanny packs.
Sandbox_RVA_Food_tooltip:
Removes all food and drink.
Turning this on makes the individual food options below redundant.
Sandbox_RVA_Food_Perishable_tooltip: Fresh food that rots: meat, produce, dairy, baked goods.
Sandbox_RVA_Food_NonPerishable_tooltip: Tinned, dried and packaged food that never spoils.
Sandbox_RVA_Food_Drinks_tooltip: Bottles, cans, mugs and anything that holds a drinkable fluid.
Sandbox_RVA_Food_Cookware_tooltip: Pots, pans, baking trays and other cooking equipment.
Sandbox_RVA_Weapons_tooltip:
Removes every item the game files as a weapon.
Note: this includes dual-purpose tool weapons such as hammers, axes and frying pans.
Sandbox_RVA_Weapons_Firearms_tooltip: Guns of every kind. Ammunition is a separate option.
Sandbox_RVA_Weapons_Melee_tooltip: Swinging, stabbing and spear weapons, including tool weapons.
Sandbox_RVA_Weapons_Improvised_tooltip: Crafted, junk, household and improvised weapons.
Sandbox_RVA_Weapons_Ammo_tooltip: Bullets, shells, boxes and loose rounds.
Sandbox_RVA_Weapons_Parts_tooltip: Scopes, slings, chokes, laser sights and magazines.
Sandbox_RVA_Weapons_Explosives_tooltip: Bombs, pipe bombs, molotovs and triggers.
Sandbox_RVA_Tools_tooltip:
Removes all tools and outdoor gear.
Turning this on makes the individual options below redundant.
Sandbox_RVA_Tools_VehicleMaintenance_too: Car parts, tyres, batteries and mechanic tools.
Sandbox_RVA_Tools_Gardening_tooltip: Trowels, watering cans, fertiliser and farming tools.
Sandbox_RVA_Tools_LightSources_tooltip: Torches, lanterns, candles, lighters and matches.
Sandbox_RVA_Tools_Electronics_tooltip: Electronic scrap, remotes, timers and components.
Sandbox_RVA_Tools_Communications_tooltip: Radios, walkie-talkies, HAM sets and TVs.
Sandbox_RVA_Medical_tooltip:
Removes all first aid supplies.
Turning this on makes the individual options below redundant.
Sandbox_RVA_Literature_tooltip:
Removes all books, magazines and maps.
Turning this on makes the individual options below redundant.
Sandbox_RVA_Literature_SkillBooks_toolti: Skill books that boost XP gain.
Sandbox_RVA_Literature_Magazines_tooltip: Magazines, including recipe and schematic magazines.
Sandbox_RVA_Containers_tooltip: Crates, boxes, jars and other non-wearable containers.
Sandbox_RVA_JunkMementos_tooltip: Worthless clutter, trinkets, toys and keepsakes.
Sandbox_RVA_CraftingMaterials_tooltip: Planks, nails, thread, ingots and other crafting resources.
Sandbox_RVA_AnimalParts_tooltip: Hides, bones, feathers, antlers and butchered parts.
Sandbox_RVA_Instruments_tooltip: Guitars, drums and other musical instruments.
Sandbox_RVA_SportsEquipment_tooltip: Balls, bats, rackets and sports gear.
Sandbox_RVA_HouseholdItems_tooltip: Cleaning supplies, paint, and general household goods.
Sandbox_RVA_ApplyToCorpseLoot: Apply to zombie & corpse pocket loot
Sandbox_RVA_ApplyToCorpseLoot_tooltip:
Off by default, so zombies keep carrying the odds and ends in their pockets even when you have stripped those items from containers.
Turn it on and corpse inventories are stripped too.
Note: the clothes a zombie wears are defined outside the loot tables and are not affected by this mod at all.
Sandbox_RVA_ApplyToModdedItems_tooltip:
Off by default, so only vanilla items are removed.
Turn this on and any modded item matching an enabled category is removed too.
Sandbox_RVA_LogRemovals_tooltip: Writes a per-category summary to console.txt on world load. Useful for checking the mod is doing what you expect.
Sandbox_RVA_PurgeExistingVehicles: Also remove vanilla vehicles already in the world
Sandbox_RVA_PurgeExistingVehicles_toolti:
For saves already in progress. Normally a vehicle only stops spawning in areas you have never visited, so an established save keeps its old cars forever.
Turn this on and any vanilla vehicle you have removed is deleted from the world as you come across it.
This destroys cars you may have repaired, fuelled or filled with loot. A car with someone sitting in it is left alone.
Sandbox_RVA_PurgeExistingLoot: Also strip containers that have already been looted
Sandbox_RVA_PurgeExistingLoot_tooltip:
For saves already in progress. Containers you have never opened always roll fresh, so this only affects ones you have opened before.
That includes your own base: this will delete matching items out of your stashes. Your character's own inventory and bags are never touched.
